message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO". The background is white with red borders. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red capital letters at the top. Below this, three caricatured human figures are shown.

Two large men in green and brown camouflage military uniforms stand in profile, facing each other. The man on the left has four stars on his shoulder epaulet and a mustache. The man on the right has rolled-up sleeves revealing large, muscular arms. Between these two giants stands a much smaller, slender man in a white long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. He has his arms crossed over his chest and a weary facial expression, appearing squeezed between the two larger figures.

Text above the "TEMPO" logo reads: "MAIN PERKARA PIMPINAN KPK" and "SENGKARUT PROYEK KILANG TPPI". Central text reads: "MANUVER CALON PANGLIMA" and "Laksamana Yudo Margono dan Jenderal Andika Perkasa berebut kursi Panglima TNI. Jokowi merestui siapa?". In the bottom left, there is a date "20-26 SEPTEMBER 2021", a price "RP 45.000", a website, a barcode, and a QR code.
